_comment: Synthetic example for `npm run live-replay -- --expectations reference/live-replay-expectations.example.json`: the fictional northwind fixtures (Salesforce + M365). The real expectations file lives in the git-ignored local/ directory and holds real paths; it is never committed. Only `scenarios.<id>.runs[]` and `scenarios.<id>.validate.<name>` entries are replayed; other keys are ignored. `status` is compared with the stdout `status` when present.

m365.command: npm run -s m365-capture-plan -- --validate fixtures/m365-northwind/capture.json --account-id sf_001SYN0000000001AA --m365-mapping fixtures/m365-northwind/mapping.yaml

runs.label: first meeting
runs.command: npm run -s prepare-first-meeting -- --account "Northwind Traders" --source capture --capture fixtures/salesforce-northwind/capture.json --capture-m365 fixtures/m365-northwind/capture.json --m365-mapping fixtures/m365-northwind/mapping.yaml --output json

runs.label: source rank
runs.command: npm run -s source-rank -- --source capture --account sf_001SYN0000000001AA --capture fixtures/salesforce-northwind/capture.json --capture-m365 fixtures/m365-northwind/capture.json --m365-mapping fixtures/m365-northwind/mapping.yaml --output json

runs.label: public ceiling withholds the records
runs.command: npm run -s source-rank -- --source capture --account sf_001SYN0000000001AA --classification public --capture fixtures/salesforce-northwind/capture.json --capture-m365 fixtures/m365-northwind/capture.json --m365-mapping fixtures/m365-northwind/mapping.yaml --output json

runs.label: no match
runs.command: npm run -s prepare-first-meeting -- --account zzqxv --source capture --capture fixtures/salesforce-northwind/capture.json --output json
